source.caption: Left, the unbalanced MIC target values before performing the data preprocessing , Right , the balanced MIC target values after performing the required data preprocessing where the active peptides with MIC value 1.0 were reduced to be equal to the MIC with 0 label counts. The dataset was divided into two subsets randomly: training and validation, with ratios of 80% and 20%, respectively.
